desc: The garden's daily hooks (scripts/home/garden_wishes.gd, scripts/home/garden_away.gd; briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 5, ranks 1 and 3). Each garden day three Boki wish for something (a need back up); granting one is a gift, nothing is ever taken for missing a day. Coming back after time away brings small gifts. Nothing here lowers a need or a stat.
day_s_doc: Seconds in one garden day (the local calendar day, cut at midnight).

wishes.count_doc: Wishes picked each garden day, one card.
wishes.needs_doc: The needs a wish can be for (the same four KinWants shows as thought bubbles).
wishes.pick_below_doc: A Boki is only picked for a need that is under this (0 to 100), so a wish always has something to do.
wishes.wish_to_doc: The wish is granted when that need is back at or above this (0 to 100), however it got there: you, a toy, a feeder.
wishes.trust_doc: Trust points (0 to 100) the Boki gains when its wish is granted.
wishes.item_doc: The small item a granted wish puts in the pantry (Save.d items).
wishes.bonus_doc: Gems for all the wishes of the day (the Sunsap of GARDEN_MODERN.md 1.2 stands in until the item engine is merged).
wishes.tip: Grant one for trust and a snack; all %d give %d gems. Miss a day and nothing is lost.

away.gift_every_h_doc: Hours away for each small gift a Boki saves you (a snack of its leading lean).
away.gift_max_doc: Most gifts on one return (so 6 hours away fills it).
away.toy_rate_doc: Share of the at-home training speed toys keep while you are away.
away.toy_cycle_s_doc: Seconds one stat point takes at a toy while you are home (play time plus the walk to it).
away.toy_cap_doc: Most stat points one Boki trains on one return, never past its level cap.
away.patch_overflow_max_doc: Most extra snack-patch batches (beyond the one that waits on the patch) that go to the feeder bowl on one return.
